key_phrases: strong demand for our leading-edge process technologies
narrowing the range of our 2025 CapEx to be between USD 40 billion and USD 42 billion
margin dilution from the ramp-up of our overseas fabs
analysis.reasoning: The call reflects extremely strong performance driven by AI demand, with the CEO using highly bullish language ('insane' numbers, 'explosive growth'). Financials beat guidance in USD terms. CapEx guidance was narrowed upward, signaling high confidence in long-term structural demand. While there is explicit mention of risks regarding overseas fab margin dilution and potential tariff impacts, the management remains highly confident in their technological moat (N2, A16 roadmap). QA evasion was present only when discussing specific capacity numbers for CoWoS or exact revenue per GW of data center, which is standard for TSMC. Quantitative specificity was exceptionally high with detailed breakdowns of technology mix and platform revenue.
